# Genuine appliance fixtures

No genuine captures are committed here. This directory is reserved for reviewed examples captured from LE. Synthetic inputs live separately in tests/synthetic.

Use scripts/Export-LiveCapture.ps1 with a supplied run ID and a new private output path. Retain original responses, request/page metadata, screenshots and restoration observations privately. Confirm shapes against the matching spec.

Before committing any derivative, review every field, filename and image for credentials, hosts, addresses, accounts, customer information and internal URLs. IDs may be identifying and should use consistent aliases when published. Unknown free text and screenshot pixels need explicit review. Keep a private mapping and provenance record. Do not call edited success JSON a genuine failure capture.

Public allowlist bundles intentionally omit raw responses and screenshots. A shape-preserving fixture requires separate careful human review. Record source version, scenario, transformations and capture coverage without exposing the private source.
